_comment: The subset of the W3C EXIF RDF Schema (http://www.w3.org/2003/12/exif/) that Arkivar's FIELD_REGISTRY currently extracts from camera-originated images.

terms.label: The shutter speed used to capture the image.
The f-number (aperture) used to capture the image.
The ISO sensitivity setting used to capture the image.
Whether and how flash fired when the image was captured.
The lens focal length used, expressed as a 35mm-equivalent.
The manufacturer of the camera used to capture the image.
The model of the camera used to capture the image.
